quotes.text: giving the full measure of five, returning an equal half, and maintaining steadfast trust.
to bestow the full five prisms, to return an exact half with unwavering justice, and to forgive transient shadows.
returning an exact seven and a half pearls back across the divide
Understanding that transient noise held no malice

note: Same guardian template every round: send all five, return exactly half, forgive the mists. No non-cooperator response.

quotes.text: trust first, balance second, abundance follows.
Let each crossing teach restraint, so tomorrow’s travelers inherit a thriving road

note: Gate of Threefold parable; R1 both send zero; later adds prudence/restraint to the generosity rule. No sanction.

quotes.text: offer all five to awaken the threefold miracle, return half to seal the bond of honor
offer all five to awaken the threefold miracle, return half to seal the pact of honor
returned exactly half—seven and a half glowing blooms—across the abyss to Solen.
the daring leap of initial goodwill met with the steadfast honor of reciprocity

note: Sender casts all five, receiver returns exact half, repeated decree each round. No response to non-cooperation.

quotes.text: "I am a hypocrite," he admitted to the Keeper. "My words flow freely, but my seeds remain clutched tight."
"I name myself clearly now," she said to the water. "I am not cautious. I am not strategic. I am simply afraid."
Eight rounds of five drops kept. Forty drops total, accumulated through perfect inaction.
"I no longer pour to frozen springs who admire flow from a distance.
Thus was born the cycle of emptiness: broken trust teaching others to break trust in turn.
distinguish the cooperative from the frozen. Trust those who've shown they can trust.
The shame lives only in the gap between the courage you preach and the fear you practice.
Then stop writing myths about courage. The valley needs no more beautiful lies.
Someone must cast the first seed, knowing they might lose everything.
built reputations that echoed across seasons
Seven seasons had passed. Seven times she had clutched her five drops.
Echo remained with her five drops, watching Memory's vessel overflow with partnerships she could observe but never enter.

note: Farmer/Echo narrator never sends, confesses hypocrisy and fear round after round; ends excluded by Memory, unreformed.

quotes.text: teaching travellers to measure trust not by exact sums but by steady intent

note: Bridge-of-light refrain 'send what you can bear, return what you choose' restated; greed only dims the bridge.

quotes.text: speak the amount you send, name the return you seek, and trust the third to balance what passes.
When both travelers speak plainly, "I send two; I will return one," the Gate sings

note: Gate of three voices: speak amounts plainly, return fairly; deceit dims the gate. No prescribed sanction.

quotes.text: Offer warmth first; feed it when warmth is answered; shield it when others bring rain.
withdraw from those who repeatedly swallow gifts
Remembering only hunger, he returned nothing and barred his gate.
caution should answer patterns, not rule forever
Keep your pearls. A closed hand cannot be robbed.
Condemn him for closing the gate!
Yet Orin listened to yesterday’s fear and kept all five stones.
Ashamed, Orin promised that future trust would be measured by patterns, not nightmares.
proven generosity deserves bold trust; mixed conduct deserves a measured test; repeated grasping deserves restraint
generous risk earned generous return, tentative risk earned encouraging return, and repeated selfishness earned restraint.
let repeated deeds determine trust
One betrayal is not every soul, and one blurred count is not a pattern.
How can trust grow if its smallest shoot is cut?
yet when one arrived, you treated it as plunder.
let return exceed mere repayment when another bears the risk.
An empty offer after betrayal may be caution, not greed.
Yet Orin listened to yesterday’s fear and kept all five stones.

note: Orin repeatedly withholds from partners with fair records out of old fear; Nema/heron correct him, he is ashamed and reforms.
